offering_description.value: Investment management of real asset and income strategies, including real estate, infrastructure, commodities, listed income and multi-asset portfolios. Sold to institutional investors and individuals through funds and separate accounts, earning fees on the assets it manages.

primary_products.value: open-end mutual funds; exchange-traded funds; closed-end funds; separate accounts; institutional commingled funds

customer_segment.value: B2B: institutional investors, pension plans, insurers, sovereign wealth funds, financial advisors and wealth managers; B2C: individual investors who buy its funds through brokerage and advisory platforms

end_markets.value: asset management; retirement and pension savings; wealth management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: management fees charged as a percentage of assets under management, plus performance fees on some strategies

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: pools investor capital into funds and manages it for institutional and individual clients; service provider: provides investment advice and portfolio management to clients under separate account mandates

geography_served.value: global: clients in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: real estate, infrastructure, commodities, listed income, preferred securities and multi-asset strategies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house institutional sales team serving pension plans and consultants; partners / resellers: broker-dealers and wealth platforms that offer its funds to individual investors; agents / brokers: financial advisors and consultants who recommend its strategies to clients
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; partners / resellers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser and fund sponsor under SEC rules, Investment Company Act of 1940, and FINRA oversight
